raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

  `vllm/models/inkling/` has an NVIDIA implementation built on CuTe/FA4 and
  Lamport P2P, and a Triton implementation under `amd/`. XPU has neither of the
  NVIDIA dependencies, so it currently crashes in `nvidia/ops/lamport.py` on a
  `torch.cuda.get_device_capability()` call.

  The Triton implementation is not AMD-specific - it is plain Triton plus vLLM
  layers. Rather than add platform checks inside an AMD-owned directory, this
  moves it to `inkling/common/`, next to the already backend-neutral
  `mm_preprocess.py` and `towers.py`, and routes both ROCm and XPU to it.
  `inkling/amd/` keeps only the gfx950 Gluon kernels, and `inkling/nvidia/` is
  untouched.

  Platform differences move out of the kernels into `common/platform.py`:

  - `gluon_rel_attention()` offers each relative-attention call to the Gluon
    kernels on ROCm and returns `None` elsewhere, which also removes the stubbed
    `on_gfx950` import guard
  - `num_compute_units()` sizes the persistent Triton grids

  The qkvr K/V branch now runs inline when `aux_stream()` is `None`.

  The first commit is the routing plus portability fixes; the second is the move,
  which is renames plus import paths.

  ## Test Plan

  Kernel parity against the torch reference on Battlemage B70, tensor parallel 1
  and 2, page sizes 16/32/64/128, both the plain and the QK-sensitive scaling:
  attention 432 cases, and qkvr/sconv/norm/gate/SwiGLU 89 cases. End to end, the
  model serves on eight B70 cards at tensor parallel 8 and answers sequential and
  concurrent requests. Behaviour was also compared against the pre-move tree under
  an identical configuration and is byte-identical.

  ROCm is unchanged by construction: the moved files are renames, and the Gluon
  dispatch is reached through the new hook. The ROCm-only tests were updated for
  the new paths but not executed, as that requires CDNA4 hardware.

  ## Test Result

  All 521 kernel parity cases pass. The eight-card run serves and responds; 10/10
  sequential and 8/8 concurrent requests succeed.



## Logs

<details>
<summary>Kernel parity logs (Intel Battlemage B70, triton-xpu 3.8.0, torch 2.14.0+xpu)</summary>

Each case compares the Triton kernel against a torch reference on identical
bf16 inputs. `@qks` cases use a QK-sensitive scaling so the `Q.K^T` term
dominates; those are the `BLOCK_Q > 1` prefill shapes.

```
SUMMARY pass=432 fail=0 skip=0 elapsed_s=405

CASE attn:tp1/local/p32/packed/prefill_short@qks      PASS qk_mode=sensitive path=main max_abs=0.00906 mean_abs=0.000532 finite=True q_lens=[64]              kv_lens=[64]
CASE attn:tp1/local/p32/packed/prefill_gt_window@qks  PASS qk_mode=sensitive path=main max_abs=0.00917 mean_abs=0.000244 finite=True q_lens=[700]             kv_lens=[700]
CASE attn:tp1/local/p32/packed/prefill_gt_rel@qks     PASS qk_mode=sensitive path=main max_abs=0.00841 mean_abs=0.000196 finite=True q_lens=[2048]            kv_lens=[2048]
CASE attn:tp1/local/p32/packed/prefill_ragged@qks     PASS qk_mode=sensitive path=main max_abs=0.00904 mean_abs=0.000251 finite=True q_lens=[300, 17, 1024]   kv_lens=[300, 17, 1024]
CASE attn:tp1/local/p32/packed_nhd/prefill_short@qks  PASS qk_mode=sensitive path=main max_abs=0.00792 mean_abs=0.000535 finite=True q_lens=[64]              kv_lens=[64]
CASE attn:tp1/local/p32/packed_nhd/prefill_gt_win@qks PASS qk_mode=sensitive path=main max_abs=0.01072 mean_abs=0.000244 finite=True q_lens=[700]             kv_lens=[700]
```

Worst deviation across all 216 QK-sensitive cases is `max_abs=0.01344`.

```
SUMMARY pass=89 fail=0 skip=0 elapsed_s=25

CASE qkvr:conv4-p32/tp1/local/small_prefill PASS path=small              tokens=9   q_max_abs=0.0     rel_max_abs=0.0     key_max_abs=0.0 value_max_abs=0.0 conv_cache_max_abs=0.0
CASE qkvr:conv4-p32/tp1/local/small_chunk   PASS path=small              tokens=40  q_max_abs=0.0     rel_max_abs=0.0     key_max_abs=0.0 value_max_abs=0.0 conv_cache_max_abs=0.0
CASE qkvr:conv4-p32/tp1/local/small_decode  PASS path=small              tokens=8   q_max_abs=0.0     rel_max_abs=0.0     key_max_abs=0.0 value_max_abs=0.0 conv_cache_max_abs=0.0
CASE qkvr:conv4-p32/tp1/local/tiled_128     PASS path=tiled(no-aux-stream) tokens=128 q_max_abs=0.00098 rel_max_abs=0.00391 key_max_abs=0.0 value_max_abs=0.0 conv_cache_max_abs=0.0
```

The `tiled(no-aux-stream)` path is the `fused_qkvr_prep` branch this PR makes
reachable when `aux_stream()` returns `None`.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Eight-card serve log (tensor parallel 8, online MXFP4 MoE weights)</summary>

```
Initializing a V1 LLM engine (v0.31.1rc1.dev273+g2eb491e18) with config:
  dtype=torch.bfloat16, max_seq_len=4096, load_format=auto,
  tensor_parallel_size=8, pipeline_parallel_size=1,
  quantization=mxfp4,
  quantization_config=QuantizationConfigArgs(
      linear=QuantSpec(weight=None, activation=None),
      moe=QuantSpec(weight=QuantKey(dtype=torch.uint8,
          scale=ScaleDesc(dtype=torch.uint8, static=True,
                          group_shape=GroupShape(row=1, col=32)),
          symmetric=True), activation=None),
      ignore=[], targets=None),
  enforce_eager=True, kv_cache_dtype=auto, device_config=xpu,
  tokenizer_mode=inkling, trust_remote_code=False, seed=0

world_size=8 rank=0 local_rank=0 backend=xccl
world_size=8 rank=1 local_rank=1 backend=xccl

world_size=8 rank=5 local_rank=5 backend=xccl
world_size=8 rank=6 local_rank=6 backend=xccl
world_size=8 rank=7 local_rank=7 backend=xccl

[default_loader.py:498] Loading weights took 1.67 seconds
[mxfp4.py:2155] Using MoEPrepareAndFinalizeNoDPEPModular
[mxfp4.py:2156] Using XPUExpertsMxFp4
[model_runner.py:424] Model loading took 18.87 GiB memory and 4.086078 seconds   (rank 0)
[model_runner.py:424] Model loading took 18.87 GiB memory and 4.286610 seconds   (rank 7)
[gpu_worker.py:745] Available KV cache memory: 0.73 GiB
[core.py:397] init engine (profile, create kv cache, warmup model) took 15.19 s
INFO:     Application startup complete.
```

Request smoke after startup: 10/10 sequential completions in 16 s, then 8/8
concurrent completions in 2 s, no errors.

Note the weights are MXFP4-quantized at load time, which is what makes the
model fit (18.87 GiB per rank of a 30.3 GiB card). Generation quality under
that quantization is a separate, pre-existing question and is not affected by
this PR: the same configuration on the tree before the directory move produces
byte-identical output.

</details>

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Platform queries for the shared Inkling implementation.
+
+Keeps per-platform device introspection out of the kernels, which otherwise
+have to reach for CUDA-specific APIs to size their grids.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+
+def num_compute_units(device: torch.device) -> int:
+    """SM / CU / Xe-core count used to size persistent Triton grids."""
+    index = device.index
+    if index is None:
+        index = torch.accelerator.current_device_index()
+    return current_platform.num_compute_units(index)
